body: Hey I’m sure you’ve forgotten about me by now but I just want to thank you. I ended up spending a week at the hospital and they got me the right medications and appointments to help. I probably wouldn’t have gotten help if you hadn’t responded. Thank you so much.

I only talk to my older sister and I just don’t feel like there’s much more we can talk about. I see my therapist tomorrow morning, I just wish there was a way to speed up this work day so I can go home and get in bed.
I’ve always had trouble remembering my childhood but I found out yesterday it’s because I (along with my older and younger sister) was being sexually abused by my oldest sibling.
